verdicts.detail: Platform 2 is reached by the lift between the concourse or ticket office and platform 2 and the survey records no other step-free way to it, so step-free access was gone while this was listed. Platform 1 never needed this lift. The notice also names platform 1, which no recorded lift touches. Irish Rail's page: "Lift to platform 2".
verdicts.text: Lifts at platforms 1 and 2 are currently out of service. Iarnród Éireann Irish Rail apologise for the inconvenience caused.

verdicts.detail: An escalator is moving stairs, so it was not a step-free route to begin with and its being out did not remove one. Anyone who finds a flight of stairs hard, or has a buggy, a suitcase or a stick, did lose a way up. The survey records a lift between the station entrance and the concourse or ticket office as well; the feed says nothing about whether that lift ran.
verdicts.text: The Escalator at the main concourse is currently out of service. Iarnród Éireann Irish Rail apologise for any inconvenience caused.
